calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Your past and upcoming bookings, and your own events.

sync.title: Sync with your calendar
sync.intro: Subscribe Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook to your bookings and events. New bookings then appear there by themselves.
sync.privateHost: This address only exists on your own network, so Google and other online calendars cannot read it. It works once the app is deployed online.
sync.privacy: Anyone who has this link can see your bookings and events. Do not share it.
sync.stepsTitle: Or by hand in Google Calendar
sync.step1: On a computer, open Google Calendar.
sync.step2: Next to "Other calendars", click + then "From URL".
sync.step3: Paste the link above and click "Add calendar".
sync.delay: Google refreshes subscribed calendars every few hours, so a new booking can take a while to show up there.
sync.resetConfirm: The old link stops working at once. Calendars that use it must be given the new link.
